theorems.name: Submission.frt_vgm_ext_prod_of_finite_rectangles
theorems.statement: ∀ (X Y : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] [MeasurableSpace Y] (μ : Measure X) (ρ₁ ρ₂ : Measure (X × Y)), SigmaFinite μ → (∀ A : Set X, MeasurableSet A → μ A ≠ ∞ → ρ₁ (A ×ˢ (univ : Set Y)) ≠ ∞) → (∀ (A : Set X) (B : Set Y), MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet B → μ A ≠ ∞ → ρ₁ (A ×ˢ B) = ρ₂ (A ×ˢ B)) → ρ₁ = ρ₂
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
